newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Surgical bids $57.5 mln for Imagyn.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Surgical bids $57.5 mln for Imagyn.

text.p: United States Surgical Coro said Wednesday it has proposed to buy Imagyn Medical Inc for $57.5 million in cash or stock.
Leon Hirsch, chairman of USS, said "Imagyn's product lines would be an important addition to our women's health care initiative program."
"We just received the unsolicited offer and our board of directors is currently scheduling a meeting to review the offer," a spokeswoman of the Laguna Niguel, Calif., -based company told Reuters.
"We will make no further comment at this time," she added.

Imagyn designs, develops and sells devices for the diagnosis and treatment of gynecological and reproductive disporders. It exclusively supplies U.S. Surgical with MiniSite 2mm laparascope, the centerpiece of U.S. Surgical's microlaparoscopic line of products.

Imagyn recently received approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to market its MicroSpan microhysteroscope, which provides access to the uterus without cervical dilation and the Ovation System used to assess infertility.
U.S. Surgical is a diversified surgical products company specializing in minimally invasive technologies.
